sections.heading: What it is
paragraphs: An educational game about a lifetime of money for a young professional in India. Pick a person, make the big calls at each stage of life, and watch how your choices and a bit of luck add up over the decades.

sections.heading: What it is not
paragraphs: This is not financial, tax or investment advice. The numbers are illustrative and simplified, and real life, real laws and real markets are messier. Talk to a qualified adviser before you decide anything with real money.

sections.heading: Where the numbers come from
paragraphs: Most numbers are rounded game values or rough estimates from public sources as of 2026 (the RBI, tax rules, bank rates, press summaries). Every one has a source note and a confidence level. Under "Advanced: under the hood" on the screen where you pick a person, "Where the numbers come from" lists them all.

sections.heading: What is simplified
bullets: Only the new income-tax regime, with no deductions to optimise.
One kind of home to buy, with one fixed-rate 20-year loan.
A partner is an income, not a second person with a career of their own.
Money you cannot spend (a home you live in) is not counted as savings.
Luck comes from a seed: the same seed and the same choices give the same life.

sections.heading: Your data
paragraphs: Nothing leaves your browser. Your progress, your last choice of person and your display choices are saved on this device only. "Forget my progress" on the first screen clears a saved life.
